name: Apple News+
description:
This is a remake of an Apple News+ commercial. Recreated to show what's possible in Bali Bliss. All credit for the original design goes to them.

It showcases some uses of core motion design techniques like:
- Clipping content
- flipping card transitions
- Text animations

This template is fairly complex. Enjoy!
